leadGenBar.headline: Reliable. Scalable. Fast. Accurate.
leadGenBar.title: Engineering-Grade Surveying & Geospatial Solutions Across Kenya and East Africa
leadGenBar.description:
At SmartGrid Surveying, we don’t just measure land—we deliver <bold>accurate, decision-ready spatial data</bold> that engineers, developers, and project managers rely on to plan, design, and execute with confidence.

 From <bold>topographical surveys and cadastral mapping</bold> to <bold>drone mapping, LiDAR, and underground utility detection</bold>, we provide end-to-end geospatial solutions tailored for modern construction and infrastructure projects

items.label: Land Surveying
items.description: We provide a wide range of land surveying services, including topographical surveys, boundary surveys, sectional properties, building site surveys, resource mapping, bathymetric surveys, hydrographic surveys, and GIS mapping. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.description: Every project is delivered with professional, ready-to-use outputs tailored to the project needs:

items.title: Boundary Survey Reports & Plans
items.description: Signed reports and plans defining parcel boundaries for transactions, development, and dispute resolution.

items.title: Cadastral Plans for Title Processing
items.description: Registry-compliant cadastral plans prepared for submission to the land registry for title issuance.

items.title: Beacons Monumentation
items.description: Durable boundary beacons placed and referenced to survey accuracy, protecting your parcel corners.

items.title: Registry Maps
items.description: Certified registry index maps and extracts for parcel verification and due diligence.

items.title: 3D Spatial Data (X, Y, Z)
items.description: Positional coordinates ready for design, GIS databases, and machine-control workflows.

items.title: Topographical Maps
items.description: Feature-coded maps of terrain, utilities, structures, and levels for planning and engineering design.

items.title: Contours
items.description: Major and minor interval contours for grading, drainage, and earthworks design.

items.title: CAD Shapefiles
items.description: GIS-ready shapefiles and CAD layers that drop straight into drafting and mapping workflows.

items.title: Survey Reports
items.description: Methodology, equipment, and accuracy summary signed by a licensed surveyor for approvals and records.

items.title: PDF Map Outputs
items.description: Print-ready, scaled map exports for sharing with clients, consultants, and approval authorities.

items.title: Other Specialized Deliverables
items.description: Custom outputs - volumetrics, monitoring reports, setting-out data - tailored to your project.

items.label: Aerial Surveys
items.description: We offer a wide range of aerial surveying services, including drone imagery surveys, Lidar mapping, agricultural NDVI mapping, as-built surveys, monitoring and evaluation, solar panel drone surveys, volumetric surveys, and landfill & quarry drone surveys. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.description: Every project is delivered with professional, ready-to-use outputs tailored to the project needs:

items.title: Orthorectified Imagery (Geo-Referenced) + Raw images
items.description: Georeferenced aerial imagery alongside the raw frames captured during every flight.

items.title: Orthomosaic Maps (Geo-Referenced)
items.description: Seamless, measurement-ready mosaics stitched from hundreds of georeferenced frames.

items.title: Digital Elevation Models (DTM, DSM)
items.description: Bare-earth and surface elevation models for terrain analysis, drainage, and cut-fill planning.

items.title: Contours
items.description: Vector contours generated from photogrammetry or LiDAR, ready for grading and design.

items.title: 3D Point Clouds (X, Y, Z)
items.description: Dense classified point clouds for accurate measurement, modelling, and feature extraction.

items.title: Topographical Maps
items.description: Feature-coded topographic maps prepared for engineering, planning, and GIS workflows.

items.title: CAD Shapefiles
items.description: GIS shapefiles and CAD layers that integrate directly into your drafting environment.

items.title: Volumetric Analysis Reports
items.description: Quantified stockpile, quarry, and earthwork volumes with survey-grade confidence.

items.title: Survey Reports
items.description: Methodology, equipment, and accuracy summary accompanying every aerial survey package.

items.title: NDVI & Multispectral Maps (Agriculture only)
items.description: Crop-health indices from multispectral captures to guide irrigation, inputs, and yield decisions.

items.label: Civil Engineering
items.description: We offer a wide range of civil engineering services, including site engineering, building setting out, underground utilities installation, highway engineering, stake out, leveling, benchmarking, and construction services. Our deliverables include as-built maps, digital elevation models, setting out coordinates, 3D data, contours, master plans, building layouts, CAD shapefiles, and PDF maps.

items.label: Underground utilities (Water lines, sanitation lines, electrical lines)

deliverables.label: Deliverables

items.title: AS-BUILT Maps
items.description: As-constructed maps verifying that works match the approved designs for handover and records.

items.title: Digital Elevation Models (DSM, DTM)
items.description: Surface and terrain models supporting grading, drainage design, and quantity checks.

items.title: Setting Out Coordinates
items.description: Precise positions for structures, roads, and services - ready for stakeout on site.

items.title: 3D DATA (X, Y, Z)
items.description: Three-dimensional positional data for machine control, modelling, and design verification.

items.title: Contours
items.description: Contours at engineering intervals for earthworks, levels, and drainage design.

items.title: Master Plans
items.description: Composite site plans consolidating layouts, services, and levels for the whole development.

items.title: Buildings Layout / BIM
items.description: Building layouts and BIM-ready geometry for coordination across design and construction teams.

items.title: CAD Shapefiles
items.description: GIS shapefiles and CAD layers that drop straight into your engineering workflows.

items.title: PDF Map
